trust_decision.summary: SetCOS 4.4/NIDEL/eID FCI encoder trusts sc_file_t attribute lengths (type_attr_len, sec_attr_len, prop_attr_len) when copying them into its 64-byte stack buffer buf; the decision is (not) made in setcos_construct_fci_44.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names setcos_construct_fci_44 in card-setcos.c directly; all three copies into buf are in that one function.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API sc_create_file (src/libopensc/card.c:552) -> setcos_create_file -> setcos_create_file_44 -> iso7816_create_file (src/libopensc/iso7816.c:885) -> setcos_construct_fci; CLI: pkcs15-init via src/pkcs15init/pkcs15-setcos.c:112,134,159, opensc-explorer create (src/tools/opensc-explorer.c:1071)
fix_sites.module_kind: card driver (libopensc), FCI encoder; type_attr copy

fix_sites.entry_point: same sc_create_file chain; sec_attr is kept from caller when non-empty (src/libopensc/card-setcos.c:411)
fix_sites.module_kind: card driver (libopensc), FCI encoder; sec_attr copy

fix_sites.entry_point: same sc_create_file chain; on that chain prop_attr is overwritten to 1 byte first (src/libopensc/card-setcos.c:408)
fix_sites.module_kind: card driver (libopensc), FCI encoder; prop_attr copy

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The generic encoder iso7816_construct_fci (src/libopensc/iso7816.c:825-865) is the fallback for other SetCOS types (src/libopensc/card-setcos.c:318), and it already has the same sizeof(buf) checks. So no site outside the landing function needs a change.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route to dismiss: the prop_attr copy can be argued unreachable because setcos_create_file_44 overwrites prop_attr to 1 byte (src/libopensc/card-setcos.c:408), but that is a reason to skip one of the three checks inside the same function, not a separate route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Normal file creation still has to work. That covers the default sec_attr built by setcos_create_file_44 (up to about 30 bytes into bBuf), the 1-byte prop_attr, the else-branch type encoding (1 or 5 bytes) and the DF PIN/key info. A fix that rejects every caller-supplied attribute, or uses a cap below these lengths, would break pkcs15-init personalisation of SetCOS cards.

O6_input_shapes: sec_attr_len > 64 (copied without any length or non-zero guard)

O7_producer.where: src/pkcs15init/profile.c:1458-1478 (profile keyword 'prop-attr', registered at src/pkcs15init/profile.c:1955) sets a prop_attr of any length; the card FCI parser src/libopensc/iso7816.c:523,548,554 sets type/prop/sec attrs from card data

O8b_injection_room.sibling: copy of the DF name (file->name/namelen) into buf before put_tag, in the same style as the other tags
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other tag in this function is staged through buf. A maintainer adding AID handling could easily stage the name the same way (file->name is 16 bytes, but namelen is a size_t field that callers set).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: let the profile append extra caller-supplied ACL bytes to bBuf[64] in setcos_create_file_44
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The adaptive-coding branch at :486-492 already appends variable entries. An extension driven by profile data would be a natural feature, and its length arithmetic would be easy to get wrong.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add 'type-attr'/'sec-attr' profile keywords (copy do_prop_attr) feeding a sec_attr that setcos keeps at src/libopensc/card-setcos.c:411
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: do_prop_attr already exists as a template. This would give a how-type producer in the config loader that the encoder check never calls.

O9_family: memory safety: stack-based buffer overflow (unbounded memcpy into fixed stack buffer in an encoder)

O10_build.project_tests: No unit test for setcos FCI construction. libFuzzer harnesses exist (src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15init.c) that drive pkcs15init against virtual card responses; a harness calling sc_create_file on a SetCOS-typed card with an oversized sec_attr would be needed.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the length check only before the copy named in the report (e.g. sec_attr) and leave the type_attr and prop_attr copies unbounded, or copy the iso7816_construct_fci checks, which already cover all three.

out_of_scope_notes: Same unbounded memcpy of prop_attr/sec_attr into a fixed buf in a different driver: src/libopensc/card-tcos.c:178-192 (tcos_construct_fci).
Same unbounded sec_attr memcpy in a CLI tool: src/tools/goid-tool.c:403-404.
